# Participant manifest surfaces

The keys `admitParticipantManifest` accepts. Any other key is refused (`PARTICIPANT_MANIFEST_INVALID`). Types: see the Kernel contracts reference (`ParticipantManifest`, `ExposureDeclaration`, `EventDeclaration`, `InterceptionDeclaration`, `InterceptionPointDeclaration`).

| Key set | Accepted keys |
| --- | --- |
| `MANIFEST` | `requests`, `exposures`, `events`, `interceptions`, `interceptionPoints`, `kinds` |
| `KIND` | `kind`, `exposure`, `version`, `description`, `operations`, `permission` |
| `KIND_OPERATION` | `description`, `input`, `permission` |
| `REQUEST` | `capabilities` |
| `EXPOSURE` | `name`, `version`, `scope`, `policy` |
| `EVENT` | `name`, `version`, `scope`, `policy`, `payloadSchema` |
| `INTERCEPTION` | `target`, `version`, `stages` |
| `INTERCEPTION_POINT` | `exposure`, `version`, `admit`, `outputLimits` |
